claims.claim_text: The performance of the modular pipeline and the imitation learning approach typically differs by less than 10% under most testing conditions.
claims.normalized_text: Modular pipeline and imitation learning approaches have performance differences under 10% in most tests.

claims.claim_text: The modular pipeline performs better under the “New weather” condition than under the training conditions due to the perception system performing better on the test weathers.
claims.normalized_text: Modular pipeline outperforms training conditions in new weather due to better perception system performance.

claims.claim_text: The modular pipeline underperforms on navigation in the “New town” condition and on going straight in “New town & weather” because the perception stack fails systematically under complex weather conditions in a new environment.
claims.normalized_text: Modular pipeline underperforms in new town and weather due to perception stack failures under complex conditions.

claims.claim_text: If the perception stack is not able to reliably find a drivable path, the rules-based planner and the classic controller are unable to navigate to the destination consistently, resulting in bimodal performance where the system either works well or fails completely.
claims.normalized_text: Perception failures cause rules-based planner and controller to fail navigation, leading to bimodal system performance.
